narrative.intro: Total federal contract obligations are $494B for FY2026 to date. The ranking lists Commercial and Institutional Building Construction at $45.9B as the largest NAICS market, followed by Direct Health and Medical Insurance Carriers at $43.9B and Aircraft Manufacturing at $43.1B. Engineering Services obligated $38.3B, and Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences (except Nanotechnology and Biotechnology) obligated $35.6B. Facilities Support Services contributed $34.7B, Guided Missile and Space Vehicle Manufacturing contributed $31.6B, and Ship Building and Repairing contributed $28.5B. Computer Systems Design Services recorded $25B, while Other Computer Related Services recorded $18.2B. The page notes that all figures are contract obligations and that current-year totals are partial (fiscal year to date). Users tracking industry-level federal spending can use these NAICS-level obligations to compare absolute market sizes across sectors. Presenting each industry with its contract-obligation total highlights which industrial activities are receiving the largest federal dollars so far in FY2026 to date.

sections.heading: Which industries lead federal contracting in FY2026 to date?
sections.body: Commercial and Institutional Building Construction obligated $45.9B and is the largest NAICS market. Direct Health and Medical Insurance Carriers obligated $43.9B and Aircraft Manufacturing obligated $43.1B, showing three industries clustered at the top. Engineering Services obligated $38.3B and Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences (except Nanotechnology and Biotechnology) obligated $35.6B, completing the upper half of the top ten.

sections.heading: What other industries round out the top NAICS markets?
sections.body: Facilities Support Services obligated $34.7B and Guided Missile and Space Vehicle Manufacturing obligated $31.6B. Ship Building and Repairing obligated $28.5B, Computer Systems Design Services obligated $25B, and Other Computer Related Services obligated $18.2B. These ten industries together represent the largest federal contract markets reported for FY2026 to date.

faq.q: What are the biggest federal contracting industries?
faq.a: The biggest federal contracting industries are Commercial and Institutional Building Construction, Direct Health and Medical Insurance Carriers, and Aircraft Manufacturing. Commercial and Institutional Building Construction obligated $45.9B, Direct Health and Medical Insurance Carriers obligated $43.9B, Aircraft Manufacturing obligated $43.1B, Engineering Services obligated $38.3B, Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences (except Nanotechnology and Biotechnology) obligated $35.6B, Facilities Support Services obligated $34.7B, Guided Missile and Space Vehicle Manufacturing obligated $31.6B, Ship Building and Repairing obligated $28.5B, Computer Systems Design Services obligated $25B, and Other Computer Related Services obligated $18.2B.
